## About me
I'm Oussama, a **PhD candidate** working at the intersection of **data science**, **spatial analysis**, and **machine learning**.
My work focuses on applying clustering and explainable machine learning to real-world data — turning large datasets into insight and predictive models.
My main stack is **Python** (scikit-learn, gradient-boosting models, SHAP), and I always want to learn new things.
